description: Forward a message. Returns a preview and sends NOTHING on the first call: review the preview, then call again with the same arguments plus the confirmToken it returned (or confirm=true where the policy allows the tool) to deliver.

attach.description: Absolute paths of files to attach.

body.description: Optional note prepended before the forwarded content.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Omitted or false returns a dry-run preview.

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report what the call would do without doing it.

expectMessageId.description: Optional RFC Message-ID the id must still name: a row's messageIdHeader (request it with fields). On mismatch nothing happens and the error code is message_identity_mismatch.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

messageId.description: Compound message ID from mail_list output.

title: mail_forward: arguments
